project.name: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Limited

epics.title: Checkout Reliability Modernization
epics.description: Improve checkout stability across cart, payment, tax, discount, and order confirmation flows.
epics.businessValue: Reduce order-drop failures during peak sale traffic.

epics.title: Accessible Shopping Experience
epics.description: Bring priority shopping journeys in line with WCAG accessibility expectations.
epics.businessValue: Make cart, search, product details, and checkout usable with assistive technologies.

epics.title: Promotion and Loyalty Engine
epics.description: Support stackable discounts, loyalty wallet credits, coupon validation, and promotion auditability.
epics.businessValue: Increase campaign flexibility without increasing manual validation effort.

epics.title: Order Tracking and Notifications
epics.description: Improve shipment tracking, delivery estimates, customer notifications, and exception messaging.
epics.businessValue: Reduce support contacts caused by unclear fulfillment status.

epics.title: Search and Product Discovery
epics.description: Improve search relevance, filtering, sorting, empty states, and product recommendation behavior.
epics.businessValue: Improve product discovery and conversion from search-led sessions.

userStories.title: Apply valid promo code during checkout
userStories.description: As a shopper, I want a valid promo code to update my checkout total before payment so that I can confirm the final payable amount.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid promo code reduces the order total based on configured campaign rules.
Discount value is visible on cart, payment, and order review screens.
Expired or invalid promo code shows a clear validation message.
Promotion audit entry is created with campaign id and timestamp.

testCases.title: Apply valid percentage promo code at checkout
preconditions: Shopper has an eligible product in cart
Promo code SAVE20 is active
steps: Open cart and proceed to checkout.
Apply the code and review the order summary.
testCases.expectedResult: Discount is applied and shown consistently on cart, review, and payment screens.

testCases.title: Reject expired promo code during checkout resume
preconditions: Cart session contains a previously applied promo code
Promo campaign is expired
steps: Resume checkout using the existing cart session.
testCases.expectedResult: Expired promo code is removed and shopper sees a clear validation message.

userStories.title: Announce cart total updates to screen readers
userStories.description: As a keyboard and screen reader user, I want cart total updates announced immediately so that I understand price changes without visual cues.
acceptanceCriteria: Cart total update is announced through an ARIA live region.
Announcement contains subtotal, discount, tax, shipping, and final total.
Keyboard focus remains stable after quantity changes.
Behavior is verified on Chrome, Edge, and Firefox with supported screen readers.

testCases.title: Announce cart quantity changes to screen reader
preconditions: Screen reader is enabled
Cart has one product with quantity controls
steps: Focus the cart quantity control using keyboard.
Wait for cart totals to refresh.
Listen for the live region announcement.
testCases.expectedResult: Screen reader announces updated subtotal, discount, tax, shipping, and final total.

testCases.title: Keep keyboard focus stable after cart update
preconditions: Keyboard-only navigation is being used
Cart has an editable product quantity
steps: Tab to the quantity increase button.
Observe focus position after the cart total refreshes.
Tab to the next interactive control.
testCases.expectedResult: Keyboard focus remains on the quantity control and tab order continues normally.

userStories.title: Redeem gift card before card payment
userStories.description: As a shopper, I want to redeem a gift card before entering card details so that I can pay only the remaining balance.
acceptanceCriteria: Gift card balance is validated before card payment form is displayed.
Remaining payable amount updates after successful gift card redemption.
Fully covered order skips card entry and proceeds to review.
Failed gift card validation does not clear cart state.

testCases.title: Redeem gift card before card entry
preconditions: Signed-in shopper has active gift card balance
Cart contains an eligible product
testCases.expectedResult: Gift card can be redeemed before card details are entered and remaining amount updates.

testCases.title: Skip card entry when gift card covers full order
preconditions: Gift card balance is greater than order total
Order item is gift-card eligible
steps: Proceed to checkout as a signed-in shopper.
Place the order from review screen.
testCases.expectedResult: Card entry is skipped and the order can be placed using gift card balance only.

userStories.title: Filter search results by delivery availability
userStories.description: As a shopper, I want to filter products by delivery availability so that I only see items that can arrive within my preferred window.
userStories.blockerReason: Catalog availability feed is intermittently missing delivery-zone data.
acceptanceCriteria: Delivery filter shows available windows based on shopper postal code.
Unavailable products are excluded when filter is active.
Filter count updates after sorting or category changes.
Empty result state explains that no products match delivery availability.

testCases.title: Filter products by tomorrow delivery availability
preconditions: Postal code is set to 560001
Availability service returns delivery-window data
steps: Open the first five products from filtered results.
Validate delivery estimate on product details.
testCases.expectedResult: Filtered results contain only products deliverable tomorrow.

testCases.title: Show empty state when no products match delivery filter
preconditions: Postal code has limited catalog availability
Delivery filter is enabled
steps: Search for a low-inventory product category.
testCases.expectedResult: Empty state explains that no products match the selected delivery availability.

userStories.title: Apply loyalty wallet credit to eligible order
userStories.description: As a loyalty member, I want to use wallet credit on eligible purchases so that I can reduce the payable amount.
acceptanceCriteria: Wallet credit is visible only for signed-in loyalty members.
Eligible order total is reduced by selected wallet credit amount.
Wallet credit cannot exceed configured maximum redemption limit.
Ledger entry is created after successful order placement.

testCases.title: Apply loyalty wallet credit to eligible order
preconditions: Signed-in shopper is a loyalty member
Wallet credit is available
testCases.expectedResult: Wallet credit reduces payable amount and order is placed successfully.

testCases.title: Verify wallet ledger after credit redemption
preconditions: Wallet credit redemption order has been placed
Ledger API is available in QA
steps: Open wallet ledger for the shopper.
Validate campaign reference and rule id.
testCases.expectedResult: Ledger entry includes amount, order id, campaign reference, and redemption rule id.

bugs.title: Expired promo code accepted at checkout
bugs.description: Checkout applies a discount for an expired promo code when the code was previously cached in the cart session.
stepsToReproduce: Add any eligible product to cart.
Apply promo code SAVE20 before campaign expiry.
Keep the same cart session active after campaign expiry.
Refresh checkout and continue to payment.
bugs.expectedResult: Expired promo code is rejected and discount is removed from order summary.
bugs.actualResult: Expired promo code remains applied and order total stays discounted.
bugs.qaNotes: Issue appears related to promo validation cache not being refreshed during checkout resume.

bugs.title: Gift card balance not offered before card entry
bugs.description: Gift card redemption section appears only after card details are entered, which blocks the intended payment sequence.
stepsToReproduce: Sign in with a user that has active gift card balance.
Add an eligible product to cart.
Navigate to checkout payment step.
Observe payment methods before entering card details.
bugs.expectedResult: Gift card redemption is available before card payment form.
bugs.actualResult: Gift card option appears after card details are entered.
bugs.qaNotes: Flow ordering differs between desktop and mobile checkout.

bugs.title: Screen reader does not announce cart total updates
bugs.description: Changing cart quantity updates the visual total but does not trigger an announcement for assistive technology users.
stepsToReproduce: Open cart with screen reader enabled.
Use keyboard to increase product quantity.
Wait for cart total recalculation.
Listen for live region announcement.
bugs.expectedResult: Updated subtotal and final total are announced.
bugs.actualResult: No announcement is heard after total changes.
bugs.qaNotes: Retest should include keyboard-only flow and two screen reader/browser combinations.

bugs.title: Delivery availability filter returns stale products
bugs.description: Products unavailable for the selected postal code continue to appear after the delivery filter is applied.
bugs.blockerReason: Availability feed intermittently omits postal-code level inventory.
stepsToReproduce: Set postal code to 560001.
Search for wireless headphones.
Apply delivery availability filter for tomorrow.
Open returned products and verify delivery estimate.
bugs.expectedResult: Only products deliverable tomorrow are shown.
bugs.actualResult: Several products show delivery unavailable after opening product details.
bugs.qaNotes: Keep blocked until service feed stabilizes.

bugs.title: Wallet credit ledger entry missing campaign reference
bugs.description: Successful wallet credit redemption creates a ledger entry without the campaign reference needed for finance reconciliation.
stepsToReproduce: Sign in as loyalty member with wallet credit.
Place an eligible order using wallet credit.
Open wallet ledger audit entry.
Check campaign reference field.
bugs.expectedResult: Ledger entry includes campaign reference and redemption rule id.
bugs.actualResult: Ledger entry contains redemption amount but campaign reference is blank.
bugs.qaNotes: Functional flow passes, but reporting reconciliation is incomplete.
